problem_statement: Extend the existing public more_itertools.last API with a keyword-only default_factory=None option for constructing a fallback lazily. This is a separate custom contribution requirement on the pinned repository, not an upstream issue. Existing last(iterable, default) calls and empty-without-default ValueError behavior must remain compatible. With a callable default_factory and no explicit default, return the last item unchanged when present; on empty input call the factory exactly once and return its result, including falsey results. Never call the factory on nonempty input. None means no factory. A non-None noncallable factory raises TypeError, and supplying both an explicit default (even None) and a non-None factory raises ValueError; validate these invalid combinations before consuming the iterable. Support finite one-shot iterators without restarting them and retain support for reversible objects. Source and factory exceptions propagate. Keep top-level exports and unrelated utilities intact. Update API documentation and add focused repository regression tests. Public checks exercise behavior and existing upstream tests; they contain no reference implementation. Preserve the original 20 upstream regression methods listed in the public checks; new test methods and files are welcome.
